Featuring an extensive library of both popular and hidden gems, MetroNovel allows you to explore new worlds and characters with just a tap. With a vast array of fiction resources, MetroNovel caters to all literary preferences, providing captivating novels that will leave you spellbound.

Stay up-to-date with the latest releases and trending stories through curated recommendations tailored to your preferences. MetroNovel's intelligent algorithm learns your reading habits and suggests novels that align with your interests, ensuring you never run out of captivating content. Discover a diverse range of novels, from fantasy epics to heartwarming romances, MetroNovel caters to every reader's taste, ensuring there's always something captivating to delve into. 

Whether you're a casual reader or a devoted bookworm, MetroNovel offers a personalized reading journey that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle. Read on your own schedule, bookmark your favorite chapters, and pick up where you left off whenever and wherever you please. Dive into immersive narratives, get lost in intricate plots, and connect with compelling protagonists, all within the comfort of your mobile device.

Experience the joy of reading with MetroNovel, where imagination knows no bounds and stories come to life with every swipe. Embark on a literary adventure unlike any other and indulge in the magic of words with this exceptional online novel app!

Subscription Agreement
1. Period：monthly(auto-renewable subscriptions)
2. Price：$19.99/month
3. Payment：The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account.
4. Renewal：The Apple iTunes account will automatically deduct fees within 24 hours before the subscription expires. After successful deduction, the subscription will be postponed for one cycle.
5. Cancel：You can cancel your subscription at any time 24 hours before the subscription expires.
6. Manage subscriptions: You can view and manage your renewals.
7. Privacy:https://api.metronovel.com/privacy_policy
8. Term of Service:https://api.metronovel.com/user_agreement
